content.what_it_is: TIDE_MODULE (L52-L1075) adds constant or time-series tidal/surge boundary values on west/east/south/north edges. TIDE_INITIAL (L97-L239) reads switches and dispatches constant/data initialization; TIDE_SPONGE (L242-L313) builds directional relaxation weights; TIDE_BC (L315-L371) relaxes ETA/U/V toward boundary values; Tide_READ_CONSTANT (L373-L579) reads per-side constants; REMOVE_SPONGE (L582-L663) disables ordinary sponge widths on active tidal sides; Tide_READ_DATA_INIT (L665-L849) opens units 201-204 and loads the first Time/Eta/U/V row; TIDE_DATA (L851-L1072) advances each time series and linearly interpolates its boundary values.

unresolved: Cross-line copy/paste defect: the serial north sponge loop iterates J and I at L295-L300 but its exponent uses Nloc-i at L300, whereas the parallel north form uses Nloc-j at L298 and the south serial form uses j at L288. The serial north sponge therefore varies with the horizontal I index instead of distance from the north boundary.

Cross-line direction omission: the all-sides-disabled predicate at L647-L648 tests TideWest once and TideEast three times, omitting TideSouth and TideNorth. Consequently a configuration with only south and/or north active can execute TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. at L649 even though a tidal boundary remains enabled.

Shared EOF control-flow defect: each directional advancing READ uses END=120 (west L868, east L922, south L975, north L1028), and label 120 is after all four direction blocks at L1070. EOF on an earlier active side skips that side's interpolation and every later side's read/interpolation for the current call.

Range/singularity exposure: Iwidth comes from unvalidated WaveMakerPointNum (L117-L120), appears in denominators Iwidth-1 at L261-L300, and controls array loop bounds at L325-L360. Iwidth=1 makes the exponent division singular; Iwidth greater than Mloc or Nloc produces out-of-range or non-domain boundary indices.

Time-series ordering is not validated: DO WHILE advances while Time_*_2 < TIME+DT at L867-L869, L921-L923, L974-L976, and L1027-L1029, while interpolation divides by MAX(SMALL,ABS(Time_*_2-Time_*_1)) at L897-L899 and analogues. Duplicate or decreasing timestamps are masked rather than rejected and can consume records until the shared EOF jump.

The data-file OPEN and initial READ operations at L699-L701, L741-L743, L782-L784, and L823-L825 have no IOSTAT/ERR/END handling; missing, empty, or malformed files terminate through runtime I/O behavior rather than disabling the affected boundary.

In the parallel branch of REMOVE_SPONGE, the file-unit diagnostic for the all-false condition at L654 says TideNorth_V is unspecified, unlike the actual condition message at L653 and serial unit-3 message at L658; this is a copied diagnostic mismatch.
